todo: Phase timings for both patterns need clinical review. Breath-holds are genuinely unpleasant for some anxious users, which is why the sigh is offered as an equal alternative rather than a fallback.

patterns.name: Box breathing
patterns.summary: Four in, four hold, four out, four hold.
patterns.detail: Steady and symmetrical. Good when you want something to count.

patterns.name: Physiological sigh
patterns.summary: Two breaths in, one long breath out.
patterns.detail: No holding at any point. Pick this one if holding your breath makes things worse, which for a lot of people it does.
